skill.name: toutiao-content-research
skill.description: Research Toutiao topics and articles using SocialDataX. Compare search samples, hot-list signals, and post details to identify title patterns and editorial ideas.
skill.summary: Find Toutiao posts and turn a small sample into editorial ideas you can verify.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The workflow runs an unpinned npm CLI for research and authentication checks, and the CLI can read environment or stored credentials. Direct shell templates do not specify safe handling for user inputs or pagination tokens. Other flags matched Markdown syntax, documented links or identifiers, or readable Chinese text; no evidence of deliberate credential disclosure or reviewer-directed injection was found.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI runs a moving npm release in an environment that may contain credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release, verify package integrity, and require user approval before fetching or executing it. Prefer an already authorized MCP connection when available.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads environment credentials and supports a persistent local credential file.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a system credential store or managed secret injection. Keep access limited to the approved provider client and verify storage protections on each supported platform.

remediation.issue: Shell templates accept free-form inputs and opaque pagination tokens without a safe argument binding rule.
remediation.suggestion: Pass user inputs and service tokens as separate arguments without a shell, or use typed MCP parameters. Treat returned tokens as opaque data.

content.value_statement: It can be hard to see which angles recur in Toutiao coverage of a topic. Compare hot-list signals and relevant posts to find editorial ideas backed by examples.
actual_capabilities: Fetch the Toutiao hot list with ranking and popularity signals when available.
Search Toutiao posts by keyword and expand the sample within page or item limits.
Retrieve a post by ID, URL, or share text and report available details.
Compare recurring angles and title patterns across representative posts.
Cite links or post IDs and distinguish missing fields from reported results.
limitations: Live data requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection. Some requests may consume account credits.
Search and hot-list results are snapshots, not complete coverage or proof of a long-term trend.
Post body text, publication details, and engagement metrics may be missing.
The research workflow does not post, react, comment, or change Toutiao accounts.

use_cases.title: Build an Editorial Shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare a few posts on one topic and identify angles worth checking for an upcoming article.

use_cases.title: Brief a Team on Current Topics
use_cases.description: Summarize current hot-list entries and distinguish their rank signals from your editorial judgment.

use_cases.title: Compare Coverage Across Posts
use_cases.description: Review posts by link or ID and compare their angle, publication time, and available engagement metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review a post you already have.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this public Toutiao post: [URL or post ID]. Summarize the available text, publication time, and engagement metrics. Mark missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Check the Hot List
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Find current topics for a daily brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top five current Toutiao hot-list topics. Include ranks and any popularity signals. State when you collected the list.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Headline Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Toutiao results for [topic]. Review up to three representative posts. Compare their headline patterns and cite a link or ID for each example.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Research Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine a bounded search with current hot-list context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] using up to two search pages and ten results. Report relevant hot-list items separately. Suggest two angles and a validation step for each. Note partial results and stop before expanding the search.

output_examples.input: Compare headline patterns in a one-page sample on balcony gardening.
output: Illustrative sample: Eight posts were returned and two were reviewed in detail.
Recurring angles: Plant choices for shade and ways to save space.
Headline pattern: Several titles paired a plant list with a specific balcony condition.
Next check: Compare advice for shaded balconies across a larger sample.

output_examples.input: Review a supplied Toutiao post ID and flag fields the service did not return.
output: Illustrative result: The supplied post ID returned a title and author.
Body text and engagement metrics were unavailable.
The title mentions low-light herbs. The article's recommendations could not be verified.

best_practices: Start with a focused keyword, one result page, and no more than three representative posts.
Record the observation time, sample size, and source links or post IDs.
Use an approved connection and keep your API key out of prompts, shared notes, and logs.
anti_patterns: Treating a hot-list ranking or a small search sample as evidence of a lasting trend.
Inferring the article body or inventing engagement numbers when the service omits them.
Expanding the search or restarting partial results without checking the original limits and account credits.

faq.question: What can I provide as input?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword for search or a public Toutiao link, share text, or post ID for lookup. Hot-list requests do not need a keyword.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a locally configured key. An already authenticated hosted MCP connection can use its existing credentials.

faq.question: Will requests use account credits?
faq.answer: Some SocialDataX data requests may use credits. Check your account terms before running a larger search.

faq.question: What happens if a search returns partial results?
faq.answer: The skill marks the sample as incomplete. It can resume within the original limits if the service provides a continuation token.

faq.question: Can the skill verify claims made in a post?
faq.answer: It can summarize available post details and cite the source. It does not independently verify the author's claims.

faq.question: Can it publish or modify my Toutiao account?
faq.answer: No. The research workflow retrieves data but does not publish, like, comment, or change account settings.
